pretreatment: Si wafers deliver polished surfaces covered with an amorphous native SiO2 layer
evidence: Si (111)/SiO2(native) wafers 15 inches in diameter were used as substrates to optimize the deposition parameters for NiO films. Si wafers were chosen because their flat and well-defined surfaces allow convenient measurements of film thickness and a comparison of different ALD experiments. The near-surface region of the Si wafers has an amorphous native SiO2 layer on top.
